name: hygestat
expr: [m_s, v_s] = hygestat(50, 20, 10); [m_v, v_v] = hygestat([50 100], 20, 10); [m_b, v_b] = hygestat(50, [10 20 30], 10); [m_K0, v_K0] = hygestat(50, 0, 10); [m_KM, v_KM] = hygestat(50, 50, 10); [m_N0, v_N0] = hygestat(50, 20, 0); m_M0 = hygestat(0, 0, 10); m_KgtM = hygestat(50, 60, 10); m_NgtM = hygestat(50, 20, 60);
comment: Sig: [m, v] = hygestat(M, K, N). Hypergeometric: m = N·K/M, v = N·K·(M-K)·(M-N)/(M²(M-1)). Vectorised. K=0 / K=M / N=0 valid; M=0 / K>M / N>M / negative => NaN.
